snippet.title: Escape Velocity Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi! We hope you enjoy this trailer for our puzzle platforming first-person shooter, Escape Velocity. It's set to release next year but you can play the demo TODAY! If you enjoy it, please consider donating to our kickstarter:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ratswithwings/escape-velocity-an-explosive-first-person-puzzler

Demo link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3210690/Escape_Velocity/
